subject: Hand-off: CIO pre-brief + compact demo slot for NimbusGrid
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nimbusgrid.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Andrade <c.andrade@nimbusgrid.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request: CIO & VP attendance for product demo (NimbusGrid)

Hi Avery,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. We're nearing the final approval to evaluate Redwood for our inference footprint and the CIO (Elena Torres) asked for a concise exec-level demo for alignment with our VP of Platform (Carlos). They prefer a compact session focused on:

- Executive overview (5–7 min): high-level value and risk profile
- Live demo (18–20 min): latency/cost examples for our typical job mix
- Q&A + next steps (8–10 min)

Given tight calendars, can we secure a 35–40 minute slot the week of May 3? Our first-pass availability (PST):
- Tue May 4, 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed May 5, 09:30–11:00

I've attached a one-pager agenda and a short exec questionnaire to help tailor the demo. If useful, we'd like a 15-minute pre-brief with whoever is presenting (technical lead + executive host) the day prior.

Also, can you confirm whether an NDA or any security pre-read is required for Elena to attend?

Appreciate it — looking forward to locking this in.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Head of Partnerships, NimbusGrid
Attachments: nimbus-demo-agenda.pdf (PDF, 1 page), exec-questions.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nimbusgrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 18:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: CIO & VP attendance for product demo (NimbusGrid)

Maria — thanks, this is perfect context.

We can absolutely run a condensed, exec-focused session that follows the outline you shared. Quick notes from our side:
- Proposed slot: Tue May 4, 14:15–14:55 PT (35 minutes). We can compress the demo by ~5 minutes to leave 10 minutes for exec Q&A.
- Pre-brief: happy to do a 15–20 min pre-brief on Mon May 3 at 11:00 PT with our technical lead (Ben) and the executive host (me).
- Security pre-read: no NDA required for the high-level exec demo. For any tenant-specific config or SOC artifacts, we can share a sanitized packet under an NDA — let us know if your legal team needs that in advance.

Ben (cc) will lead the demo content; Karthik will be the backup for execution and will handle any environment-specific slides. Could you confirm Elena and Carlos' preferred timezone labels (PT/ET) and whether they prefer the demo to start on the hour or at a quarter/half? We try to match executive preferences where possible.

If you confirm the 14:15 PT slot, we'll send a calendar invite and a short presenter pre-brief invite.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nimbusgrid.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Andrade <c.andrade@nimbusgrid.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request: CIO & VP attendance for product demo (NimbusGrid)

Avery — thanks for the rapid reply and flexibility.

Elena (CIO) is PT; Carlos is actually on ET but will join from PT while traveling. The CIO prefers starts on the quarter where possible.

The May 4 14:15–14:55 PT slot works, but Elena just asked if we can shift it 15 minutes earlier to 14:00–14:40 PT because she has a standing briefing at 15:00. I realize that's tight — is 14:00–14:40 PT feasible?

I've attached a small updated calendar (.ics) with both 14:00 and 14:15 options so you can push either into your calendar. Also attaching a quick note with the exec question priorities (top two are scaling cost predictability and multi-region fallback).

If 14:00 PT is ok, please confirm final attendee names and titles so I can include them on the invite.

Best,
Maria
Maria Lopez
Head of Partnerships, NimbusGrid
Attachments: updated-calendar-candidates.ics (ICS), exec-questions-prioritized.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Maria — 14:00–14:40 PT on Tue May 4 is confirmed on our side. Final presenter & backup roster:

- Avery Johnson (Executive host) — Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference — will open and close the session (exec framing + next steps)
- Ben Carter (Technical lead) — Senior Solutions Engineer — will run the demo and handle live latency/cost examples
- Karthik Iyer (Platform specialist) — backup for environment specifics and will field deeper architecture questions if needed

We'll send a calendar invite for the confirmed 14:00–14:40 PT slot to Elena and Carlos and include a 15-minute pre-brief for Mon May 3 at 11:00 PT with Ben + me. Invite will include the one-page agenda and the prioritized exec questions you provided.

Logistics and small asks:
- Please share any sample load profiles or a short sample payload (anonymized) if you want us to run your numbers during the demo.
- If Elena needs SOC/CONF materials ahead of time, we can provide a redacted packet under NDA — let me know and we'll route.

HubSpot: I updated the deal record (NG-2027-053) with the confirmed exec slot and linked the calendar invite here: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/NG-2027-053

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

— Avery
